run.description: How fast you run, in m/s.

jump.description: How fast a jump leaves the ground, in m/s: 7.5 gets you onto a 1 m crate.

groundAccel.description: How quickly you get up to speed on the ground.

airAccel.description: How much you can steer in the air: what makes strafe-jumping work.

friction.description: How quickly you stop on the ground.

stopSpeed.description: Below this speed, friction stops you as if you were going this fast, in m/s.

speedCap.description: Running faster than this (bunny hops, blasts) fades back towards it, in m/s.

dodge.description: Shift: a quick dash in the direction you're moving, once on the ground and once more in the air.

speed.description: How fast the dash goes, in m/s.

hop.description: How fast it lifts you, in m/s.

cooldownMs.description: How long until you can dodge again, in ms.

padCooldownMs.description: A jump pad won't throw you twice within this long, in ms.

slippery.description: On slippery ground (oil): how much of the ground's friction and grip you keep.

speed.description: Share of your running speed you keep.

swim.description: How fast holding jump swims you up, in m/s.

hook.description: The grappling hook (E): it only catches where you couldn't walk to.

range.description: How far it reaches, in metres.

pull.description: How hard the rope drags you, in m/s².

speed.description: The fastest it drags you, in m/s.

arrive.description: This close to the hook, it lets go and pops you up over the edge, in metres.

hop.description: How fast it pops you up, in m/s.

cooldownMs.description: How long between firing it, in ms.

lift.description: The Lift powerup: hold jump to rise, let go to drift down.

rise.description: How fast you rise, in m/s².

fall.description: How fast you drift down, in m/s².

airAccel.description: How well you steer in the air.
